name: Hardware-Assisted Projected Tetrahedra
definition: A flexible and highly efficient hardware-assisted volume renderer grounded on the original Projected Tetrahedra (PT) algorithm. It is exclusively based on the rasterization of simple geometric primitives and takes full advantage of graphics hardware. Volume rendering is performed entirely on the GPU within a single pass through the pipeline.
summary: Hardware-Assisted Projected Tetrahedra is a GPU-only volume rendering method that streams sorted tetrahedra as point primitives, decomposing them into triangles via the geometry shader to avoid CPU sorting and data transfer overhead.
